title: Site themes
description: data/themes.json: the named token layers a page can wear. default is the site-wide theme when a page does not set front matter theme:. ?theme=<id> previews the token layer only, not homepage layout (see layouts/_partials/theme-head.html). Each theme is a token layer over shared components; home names which homepage variant to render.

previewParam.description: Query parameter that previews a theme without rebuilding. Must be theme.

colorScheme.description: dark is always dark. light-dark follows the OS, which is Reveille (today's look).
